Ph.D. Graduate Program
Our department is home to one of the largest Ph.D. graduate programs on campus, with ~150 graduate students working across ~20 research groups to tackle some of the most pressing challenges facing society. Use these pages to explore the program and discover how UMass could be the perfect fit for you.
Register for the next info session
Welcome to the Ph.D. Graduate Program at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. As the largest chemistry program in New England, we offer students the opportunity to engage in cutting-edge research across a broad range of disciplines. Join us and become an integral part of a thriving scientific community working alongside world-class researchers to push the boundaries of chemical knowledge.

Meet our graduate students
We recruit outstanding students from throughout the nation and across the globe to drive our research programs. Watch this video to hear from some of our current graduate students about why they chose UMass Amherst as a home to pursue their Ph.D. in chemistry.
